newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wlaschek does not raise CA bid - Austrian TV.
newsitem.headline: Wlaschek does not raise CA bid - Austrian TV.

text.p: The Wlaschek foundation of retail magnate Karl Wlaschek has not increased its offer for the Austrian government's stake in Creditanstalt-Bankverein, Austrian state televison said on Friday.
The deadline for the existing bidders to improve their offers expired on Friday at 0800 GMT.
The other bidders, frontrunner Bank Austria and an international consortium headed by EA-Generali, both raised their offers but declined to give details.
Wlaschek never revealed the value of his offer, but it is estimated to have been around 15 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
